body:
Karolis decided in the Plan chat (30 Oct): a veterinarian and a vet station go into this update (before: Pet update 2).
The game has no vet today (checked main, a47bb1a).
Answered 30 Oct (Game rules chat): pets DO get sick in this update (only when not fed AND not played with for long). No vet job for players.
Visit: book on the in-game phone or with the lobby nurse, come on time, go into the cabinet, nurse gives a treat, pet is happy, she reminds you of its needs.
Staff: 4 vets + lobby nurse (Living). Clinic: building, lobby desk, cabinet room, 7 furniture pieces, treat (Non-living). Spot in town (Map). Price + hours (Economy). Exam, nurse, treat and sick moves (Moves). Booking app on the phone (Screens and sound).
Stages: rules pfu-2, models and building parts pfu-4.

comments.text: Decided by Karolis in the Plan chat, 30 Oct.
Done: sick pets + vet rules answered; staff of 4 vets + nurse.
Newer approved rules win: sick if not fed OR not played with; cured at normal mood. See plan-brief-pfu-2.

short: Vet clinic + sick pets are in this update
source: chat 2026-10-30: Plan chat, Karolis asked for vet + vet station
title: Vet station and veterinarian join the Pets and Farm Update
